chapters.title: Nutrition in Plants
chapters.excerpt: Green plants prepare their own food by photosynthesis. Carbon dioxide from the air and water from the soil are the raw materials. Chlorophyll present in the leaves traps energy from sunlight. Oxygen is released into the air during photosynthesis. The presence of starch in leaves can be tested with iodine solution. Some plants with weak stems climb on other plants for support. Mushrooms and moulds show saprotrophic nutrition and grow on dead matter.
